title: Can't import tiles with correct specifications.

posts.author: LindaIsHungry
posts.body: I'm having trouble importing a tileset png, even though it's set up properly? It's an 8 bit png with indexed 256 colors, at the correct resolution and everything. If I try to import it RPG Maker gives me an error that says "Invalid PNG Image" and nothing else. I was able to import this exact file just fine earlier today, I just made a few edits and re-saved it and now this is happening. If anyone has any advice I'd really appreciate it.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: Maybe the editor changes the format? What editor are you using?

posts.author: LindaIsHungry
posts.body:

Aseprite which shouldn't be doing anything, as it was what I was using when it worked. I've also checked the file properties and everything is as described above.
